an10.93:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme
an10.93:1.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati divā divassa sāvatthiyā nikkhami. bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
an10.93:1.6: mano bhāvanīyā nampī bhikkhūnaṃ akālo dassanāya,
an10.93:2.1: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkami.
an10.93:2.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatitthiyā paribbājakā saṅgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddā mahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchāna kathaṃ kathentā nisinnā honti.
an10.93:2.3: addasaṃsu kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ,
an10.93:2.6: ayaṃ anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āgacchati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako,
an10.93:2.7: yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti, ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati.
an10.93:2.8: appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasadda vinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino.
an10.93:2.9: appeva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃviditvā upasaṃkamitabbaṃ maññeyyā”ti.
an10.93:3.1: atha kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
an10.93:3.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā tehi: aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi,
an10.93:3.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ:
an10.93:3.5: “na kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavato sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāmī”ti.
an10.93:4.1: iti kira tvaṃ gahapati, na samaṇassa gotamassa sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāsi,
an10.93:4.3: “bhikkhū tampi kho ahaṃ bhante na sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāmī”ti.
an10.93:5.1: iti kira tvaṃ gahapati, na samaṇassa gotamassa sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāsi, na pi bhikkhūnaṃ sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāsi,
an10.93:5.3: etaṃ kho bhante amhehi na dukkaraṃ vyākātuṃ “yaṃ diṭṭhikā mayanti”.
an10.93:5.4: iṅgha tāva āyasmanto yathāsakāni diṭṭhigatāni byākarontu, pacchāpetaṃ amhehi na dukkaraṃ bhavissati byākātuṃ sandiṭṭhikā mayanti.
an10.93:6.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro paribbājako anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
an10.93:8.1: aññataropi kho paribbājako anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
an10.93:8.8: ‘hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇā’ …pe…
an10.93:8.9: neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti”
an10.93:9.1: evaṃ vutte anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati te paribbājake etadavoca:
an10.93:9.5: imassāyasmato diṭṭhi attano vā ayoniso manasikārahetu uppannā, paratoghosappaccayā vā.
an10.93:9.6: sā kho panesā diṭṭhi bhūtā saṅkhatā cetayitā paṭiccasamuppannā,
an10.93:9.7: yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ tadaniccaṃ,
an10.93:9.9: yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadeva so āyasmā allīno tadeva so āyasmā ajjhūpagato.
an10.93:10.2: asassato loko, ida meva saccaṃ moghamaññanti”
an10.93:10.4: imassapi āyasmato diṭṭhi attano vā ayoniso manasikārahetu uppannā paratoghosappaccayā vā.
an10.93:10.5: sā kho panesā diṭṭhi bhūtā saṅkhatā cetayitā paṭiccasamuppannā,
an10.93:10.6: yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ tadaniccaṃ,
an10.93:10.8: yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadeva so āyasmā allīno tadeva so āyasmā ajjhupagato.
an10.93:11.8: hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇā …pe…
an10.93:11.9: neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti
an10.93:11.11: imassapi āyasmato diṭṭhi attano vā ayoniso manasikārahetu uppannā, paratoghosappaccayā vā.
an10.93:11.12: sā kho panesā diṭṭhi bhūtā saṅkhatā cetayitā paṭiccasamuppannā.
an10.93:11.13: yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ, tadaniccaṃ,
an10.93:11.15: yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadeveso āyasmā allīno, tadeveso āyasmā ajjhupagatoti.
an10.93:12.1: evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavocuṃ:
an10.93:12.2: byākatāni kho gahapati amhehi sabbeheva yathāsakāni diṭṭhigatāni,
an10.93:12.4: yaṃ kho bhante kiñci bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ, tadaniccaṃ. yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ. yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ netaṃ mama, neso hamasmi, na me so attāti evaṃdiṭṭhiko ahaṃ bhanteti. yaṃ kho gahapati kiñci bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ tadaniccaṃ, yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadeva tvaṃ gahapati allīno, tadeva tvaṃ gahapati ajjhupagatoti. yaṃ kho bhante kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ tadaniccaṃ,
an10.93:12.6: yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi’ na meso attāti
an10.93:14.4: tassa ca uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāmīti.
an10.93:15.1: evaṃ te paribbājakā tuṇhībhūtā maṅkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhānā nisīdiṃsu.
an10.93:15.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati te paribbājake tuṇhībhūte maṅkubhūte pattakkhandhe adhomukhe pajjhāyante appaṭibhāne viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yāvatako ahosi tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
an10.93:15.4: evaṃ kho te gahapati moghapurisā kālena kālaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetabbāti.
an10.93:16.1: atha kho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dhammiyā kathāya saṃdassesi, samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
an10.93:16.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an10.93:17.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkante anāthapiṇḍike gahapatimhi bhikkhū āmantesi.
an10.93:17.2: yopi so bhikkhave bhikkhu vassasatūpasampanno imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, sopi evamevaṃ aññatitthiye paribbājake sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya yathā taṃ anāthapiṇḍikena gahapatinā niggahītāti.
